name: How long does kitchen cabinet repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen cabinet repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen cabinet repair depends on the scope of work. Simple repairs like adjusting hinges or patching small chips might be completed in a few hours. More complex repairs involving sanding, repainting or staining multiple cabinets, or rebuilding drawer components can take several days. Extensive projects like cabinet refacing or structural repairs might extend to a week or more. A detailed project timeline will be provided after an assessment of your specific cabinet repair needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor fixes to several days or more for complex projects like repainting or structural repairs. A detailed timeline follows an assessment.
